title: Wireless Soil Moisture Meter (LCD + 2 TDR probes)
amazon_match_notes: Exact ASIN B0GD5WXWMY matches the Woot listing; verified as a 1-display + 2 wireless TDR sensor kit (230ft RF, moisture/temp/light), white-label equivalent to the NexusLab-Garden 2-sensor kit.

comparisons.notes: 1 display + 2 wireless TDR sensors, 230ft RF, moisture/temp/light; white-label equivalent to NexusLab-Garden 2-sensor kit. In stock and matching.

writeup: Woot has this wireless soil moisture kit new for $19.99: an LCD receiver plus two wireless TDR probes that report moisture, temperature, and light over about 230 feet of RF, with no app required. Vodeson sells the same one-display, two-sensor setup for $45.99, so this is about 56 percent below that price and saves roughly $26. Quantity is capped, with 3 or more left and a limit of 3 per customer.
